organic.description:
Platelet-rich plasma hair treatment is a non-surgical procedure that can be performed on men and women as a treatment for alopecia, or hair loss. The process starts by drawing blood that is placed in a centrifuge in order to divide the plasma and platelets from the other components of your blood. Once the plasma and platelets are separated, they will be injected into the patient's scalp to stimulate regrowth within the hair follicles. To maximize results, this procedure can be done with micro-needling. Side effects include swelling and redness directly after the procedure; however, there are no reported lasting side effects. There are no lasting side effects, but PRP hair treatment does last for about a year after the procedure is done. If you are interested in speaking to someone regarding platelet-rich plasma therapy and if it's the right fit for you, talk to the doctors at U.S. Dermatology Partners.
